d: A humanoid tree creature with a body made of dark brown bark and a head crowned with a massive, flowing mane of layered forest-green leaves. The face is integrated into the bark, featuring small, glowing yellow eyes and a wooden crown of glowing amber crystals. The build is stocky and powerful, with oversized arms ending in large, claw-like hands covered in green foliage and dark grey talons. BODY COLOR: Dark brown and forest green LEGS: Plantigrade with thick, root-like feet and dark grey toes.
